useCase: Detecting AI-upscaled images, 分辨率 篡改, and super-分辨率 processing
mechanism: 分析 the frequency 频谱 for periodic 模式 introduced by interpolation algorithms and AI super-分辨率 models. 检测 the characteristic ringing 伪影, aliasing 模式, and hallucinated high-frequency details produced by upscaling operations.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 80-90% for upscaled images with detectable interpolation 伪影
name: 放大检测
algorithm: 重采样检测 + 周期模式分析
parameters: Analysis: 2D FFT periodicity, Interpolation kernels: bilinear/bicubic/Lanczos, AI upscaler signatures: ESRGAN/Real-ESRGAN/SwinIR 模式
description: 检测 super-分辨率 and upscaling 伪影图像中的. AI upscalers introduce periodic 模式 and hallucinated details detectable through frequency 分析.

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Gallagher, A.C. (2005). Detection of Linear and Cubic Interpolation in JPEG Compressed Images. IEEE ICIVR.

strengths:
• 检测 both traditional and AI upscaling
• Frequency 分析 reveals interpolation 模式
• Can identify specific upscaling algorithms
• Effective for detecting 分辨率 篡改
limitations:
• Advanced AI upscalers minimize detectable 伪影
• Original high-分辨率 images show no 模式
• JPEG压缩 can mask interpolation 伪影
• Very slight upscaling is harder 以检测
